releases.title: Portable Flashing Package: Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.2.16
releases.source_notes:
**Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.2.16: steadier Bluetooth sound.** Linux 6.18 and the native Reborn music player for the Innioasis Y2.

## Already running Y2Linux
Settings → System → Software Update → **Update Now** (on Beta 9.2.8 and older: Settings → About & Updates → Check for Updates → **Update Now**).

## What changed
- **Steadier Bluetooth, lower default rates** (Y2Reborn #87): crackling and cut-outs on Sony WH-1000XM4 headphones came from AAC at 320 kbit/s while Wi-Fi was on; the Y2 has one antenna that Wi-Fi and Bluetooth share. AAC now runs at 220 kbit/s by default (was up to 320) and LDAC at 330 kbit/s (was 660).
- **An extra limit while Wi-Fi is on:** AAC at most 192 kbit/s and SBC one step below its top quality as long as the Wi-Fi radio is on; the full rate returns when Wi-Fi goes off. It changes while the music plays, without a reconnect.
- **Auto picks AAC first**, then aptX, then SBC; LDAC and aptX HD only when you choose them in the service menu.
- **Your chosen codec is used even when the headphones connect during playback** (Y2Reborn #87): it is asked for again at the next pause instead of being dropped until the next reconnect.

Before release: the platform's full check, Reborn's workspace tests and the tests of the release images, with new tests for the Wi-Fi limit (AAC and SBC), the defaults, Auto's order and the codec retry. **Not yet tried on a player**: if Bluetooth sounds worse or behaves differently than in 9.2.15, please send an error report (Settings → System → Error Reports).

What changed and why, in plain words: **[Beta 9.2.16 report](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/validation/Y2-LINUX-1.0-BETA-9.2.16.md)**. Everything from Beta 9.2.15 is included ([Beta 9.2.15 report](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/validation/Y2-LINUX-1.0-BETA-9.2.15.md)).

## Install (from stock)
You need SP Flash Tool v5.2032, a USB cable, **`Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.2.16-first-install.zip`** below and the **Innioasis Y2 firmware package v3.2.0** from Innioasis (only this version works; it is also your way back to stock).

1. Unpack both.
2. SP Flash Tool → **Download Only** → load `MT6582_Android_scatter.txt` **from the Y2Linux zip**. Exactly BOOTIMG, RECOVERY, ANDROID and USRDATA are ticked.
3. Click Download and connect the switched-off Y2; wait for the green tick.
4. Unplug and press Power: the player sets up its Internal Storage (a few seconds), then Y2Linux and Reborn start, music works.
5. Connect the Y2 to the computer and **copy** (don't move) `system.img` from the Innioasis package into the **Firmware** folder on **Internal Storage**. The player takes the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth firmware from it and turns the radios on.

Full guide: [INSTALL](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md) · How updates work: [Recovery and updates](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/RECOVERY-AND-UPDATES.md) · Storage: [Storage](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/STORAGE.md) · [Audiobooks](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/AUDIOBOOKS.md) · Headphone settings: [Headphone output](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/HEADPHONE-OUTPUT.md) · [Error reports](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/ERROR-REPORTS.md) · Skins: [skin guide](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/blob/main/docs/skins.md)

## Known issues (beta)
- Everything listed for Beta 9.0 still applies. If anything behaves differently from 9.2.14, send an error report (Settings → System → Error Reports); **Restore Previous System** (Settings → System → About, tap Version seven times, then Diagnostics) goes back to the version you had, with your data kept.
- Battery life in sleep: about 2 mA overnight on the developer's player (estimated from the battery voltage); stock is about 1.3 mA.
- Some players turned off by themselves during playback; the cause is not found yet. If yours does, start it again and send a report.
- The speaker uses the same volume as the headphones; its loudest step is the stock speaker's. Start low the first time.
- How loud the wheel click should be is a first guess; tell us if it is too loud or too soft.
- BBC radio stations stream only in HLS, which the player does not play yet. FM radio is in the works for a later beta.

## Files
- `Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.2.16-first-install.zip`: images, scatter files and checksums for SP Flash Tool. The data image has no SSH key (developers: `tools/production/first_owner.py`).
- `manifest.json`, `manifest.sig`, `rootfs.ext4.gz`, `bootimg.img.gz`, `recovery.img.gz`: the signed over-the-air update (Ed25519 key `platform-v1-release-20261015`, sequence 13200).
- `Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.2.16-sources-buildroot-legal-info.tar` (licences, manifests, this project's packages) and the third-party, toolchain and Linux sources linked below: corresponding sources. Our own code: Y2Linux and Y2Reborn at tag `baseline-207`. The speaker amplifier driver is Chris Hendrickson's GPL-2.0 AW87559 driver. The headphone profiles are AutoEq results (MIT, Jaakko Pasanen); their licence ships with them.
- `SHA256SUMS` for the attached files.

Beta software: use at your own risk. Not affiliated with Innioasis, MediaTek, Awinic, Last.fm, AutoEq, Strawberry or Google. Noto Sans CJK is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Details: [Beta 9.2.16 report](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/validation/Y2-LINUX-1.0-BETA-9.2.16.md).
